author: Vox
description:
Christina Applegate, the actor who has been one of the most visible faces of multiple sclerosis since her 2021 diagnosis, made a stunning revelation this week: She does not have MS after all. And her doctors still don’t know what is causing her debilitating symptoms. It is a harrowing predicament for Applegate, and hopefully her medical team is able to get her the diagnosis and treatment she needs. But the fact is, her experience is not unique.

author: Vox
description:
Scientists may have found an unexpected clue in the fight against Alzheimer’s: the shingles vaccine. When researchers compared people born just days apart — where one group was eligible for the vaccine and the other wasn’t — those who got it seemed less likely to develop Alzheimer’s. Nobody is sure why. It might calm chronic inflammation, or give an aging immune system a boost. But it’s one more sign that we’re still trying to solve a disease we don’t fully understand. #Unexplainable

author: Vox
description:
What does Health and Human Services Secretary RFK Jr. have to do with the price of eggs and sick chickens? More than you might think.

Bird flu has killed millions of chickens, driven up egg prices, and created shortages. Vaccinating poultry could help — but vaccine politics and industry opposition are standing in the way. Vox’s Kenny Torrella explains what it means for the birds and your grocery bill: https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/506937/bird-flu-vaccination-poultry-rfk-usda
